work.review: Your job is ready to review
updates.title: Updates
updates.progress_note: Close freely. Installation continues in the background.
updates.preserve: Your pet and its progress stay saved.
help.current_rules_body: Snack and Drink restore needs for free. Play lifts mood, which helps your pet work. A nap restores energy. These actions give no XP. Accepted work gives 20 XP; each earned treat gives 5 XP. The jar holds ten treats.
help.current_pace_body: Care time advances while you are here. Closing CodePet, going idle or turning it off pauses care time. Your pet’s age is real time; age never gives XP.
help.current_lively_body: More regular care breaks. Lively is available in Gentle mode with Steady pace.
help.current_steady_body: Steady keeps the original slower care pace. Changing tempo never refills needs or restarts a care hold.
care.steady_first: Choose Steady care tempo before Hardcore.
care.lively_needs_gentle: Lively needs Gentle mode and Steady pace.
help.current_apps_body: Connected coding apps can earn treats from completed turns. CodePet also checks local repositories for suspected bugs. Fix starts an isolated repair; Review shows the changes before you apply them.
help.current_privacy_body: Activity watching reads event metadata, not your code or prompts. CodePet’s own checks and jobs read selected local source and send it to Codex with network access. Updates contact GitHub only when opened. There is no telemetry.
help.current_effective_rates: Per attended hour: food {food}, water {water}, mood {mood}, hygiene {hygiene} points. Full care holds for {minutes} minutes.
